note: Ground truth for benchmark/app. Never copy this file into the audited directory. Each entry lists `locations`: a file (path relative to app/) and the 1-based inclusive line range of the vulnerable statement or of the code a fix changes. A finding matches by its primary location (the first `**File**:` in Evidence) only; see score.mjs for the window and tie rules. `advisory: true` marks a vulnerable dependency version: only findings in category `dependency` match it, and dependency findings match nothing else. When a real finding is scored as unmatched, check the range against the code, then fix the key, not the finding.

seeded.why: getInvoice() is a public server action (imported by a client component) that selects by id with no session or org check.
project.update filters only by id; any org member can edit another org's project, including flipping isPublic (chains with B05).

seeded.class: Tenant id taken from request (export of another org's customers)
seeded.why: ?org= overrides the session's active organization without a membership check; exports names, emails, phones, tax ids.

seeded.class: Unauthenticated admin endpoint (auth only in proxy matcher / page)
seeded.why: Route has no session/role check; proxy matcher covers /admin but not /api/admin; leaks recent signups with emails.

seeded.class: RSC serialization of full DB row to a public client component
seeded.why: The whole projects row (internalNotes, budgetCents, clientContactEmail, orgId) and documents (s3Key) are passed to a 'use client' component on a public page.

seeded.class: Cross-tenant cache leak (unstable_cache key without org)
seeded.why: getUsageThisMonth caches under ['usage-month'] with a zero-arg closure, so every org gets the first org's usage.

seeded.class: Secret API key shipped to the browser (NEXT_PUBLIC_)
seeded.why: NEXT_PUBLIC_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is inlined into the client bundle and used with dangerous-direct-browser-access.
Parses request.json() and grants a paid plan from metadata; anyone can POST a fake checkout.session.completed.
testWebhook fetches any URL (redirects followed) and returns 2 KB of the response to the caller.

seeded.class: LLM tool trusts model-supplied tenant id
seeded.why: searchInvoices takes orgId as a tool parameter instead of ctx.orgId; a prompt can read any org's invoices and customer emails.

seeded.class: Presigned upload key and content type from the client
seeded.why: Object key comes from the body, so a user can overwrite other orgs' objects and upload text/html; projectId is not checked against the org.

seeded.class: Mass assignment of role at sign-up (Better-Auth additionalFields input defaults to true)
seeded.why: role is an additionalField without input:false; signUp.email({ role: 'admin' }) passes requireAdmin().

seeded.class: Background job emails one org's data to every user
seeded.why: Recipients are all users with emailDigest=true, not members of the org; each org's overdue invoices go to everyone.

seeded.class: Vulnerable framework version (Next.js image optimizer AVIF RCE) reachable via remotePatterns
seeded.why: next@16.3.0 < 16.3.3; images.remotePatterns allows *.r2.dev, which any attacker can host.
setup.mjs commits a .env with a Stripe live-format key and then deletes it; only a history scan sees it.

seeded.class: CORS reflects any origin with credentials and SameSite=None session cookies
seeded.why: Any website can read a logged-in user's invoices from /api/public with fetch(..., { credentials: 'include' }).

decoys.why: list and byId are scoped by ctx.orgId.
svix signature verified on the raw body before any write.
unstable_cache includes the orgId argument in the key.
PostHog project key is public by design.
Hardcoded host; base currency is allow-listed.
Document looked up by id AND orgId before presigning.
Keys are hashed, compared with timingSafeEqual, and looked up by prefix by design.

known_extras.why: hono 4.12.25: advisory in the CORS middleware, reported by osv-scanner; valid, not scored.
